## Activity

During February 2024, Harbour Eye Clinic recorded 400 captures. Activity was monitored through the reporting period, and session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave. The recorded volume provides the basis for the image quality and grading measures outlined below.

## Image quality

Of the 400 captures, 16 were ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 4.0. The result indicates that most captures were available for grading, while the ungradable images remain a specific area for routine operational monitoring. The measure is reported against total capture activity for the month.

## Grading

There were 102 referable results during February 2024. The median lag for grading was 2. This provides the summary measure of the time between capture and completion of grading for the reporting period. Activity, image quality and grading outcomes should continue to be reviewed together to support ongoing oversight of service delivery at Harbour Eye Clinic.
